description: InfoLeap Pulse qualitative project registry. Each entry is one research study. Drop files in projects/{id}/ and hit Refresh in Quote Explorer to trigger processing.

projects.display_name: Crompton FMCD — Mixer & Food Processor Study

projects.display_name: CoinDCX Karat — Digital Gold Concept Test
